text: ここから　みあげる　ともしびやまは　でかいなあ…

structure.jp: ここから　みあげる　ともしびやまは
structure.en: Mt. Ember, looked up at from here

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ここから　みあげる　ともしびやま
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb put right before a thing describes that thing. ここから　みあげる　ともしびやま = 'Mt. Ember that you look up at from here'.

patterns.name: 〜なあ
patterns.explanation: なあ at the end shows the speaker is quietly impressed, half talking to himself. でかいなあ = 'it sure is huge'.
